children: Genius opens a second five-day airdrop claim window from 12 to 17 October 2026 for Season 2 GP holders. Eligible holders can unlock their GENIUS allocation immediately with an 85% deduction, or lock it for 24 months to receive 100% of the airdrop.

The allocations covered by these choices represent up to approximately 6% of the token's supply. An immediate claim makes only 15% of a holder's allocation available, while choosing the full allocation keeps it locked for two years. The split between the two options therefore determines how much can enter circulation during the window and how much remains unavailable for near-term selling.
If you choose not to claim a refund, a second 5-day window will open on 10/12 with two options:
Option 1: Unlock your allocation immediately with an 85% deduction.
Option 2: Lock your allocation for 24 months and receive 100% of your airdrop.

title: Genius: Second airdrop claim window opens - 12 Oct 2026 to 17 Oct 2026
